executive_orders.title: End Illegal Discrimination and Restore Merit-Based Opportunity
executive_orders.description: End illegal preferential treatment or discrimination in federal hiring, promotion, and funding. Restore fairness based on qualifications and merit.
actions: Stop identity-based preferences in recruitment, promotion, and funding
Ensure all agencies follow merit-based evaluations
Align policies with the Civil Rights Act of 1964
executive_orders.purpose: Restore merit-based equal opportunity in the federal government.

executive_orders.title: Terminate Radical and Wasteful Government DEI Programs
executive_orders.description: Critique and remove radical DEI programs that waste resources and promote ideological bias in federal agencies.
actions: Terminate DEI-related training, programs, and initiatives
Emphasize performance and merit as core management criteria
Require agencies to report program terminations
executive_orders.purpose: Eliminate unnecessary DEI programs and redirect focus to performance and ability.

executive_orders.title: Defend Women from Gender Ideology Extremism and Restore Biological Truth
executive_orders.description: Protect women’s rights in sports, education, and public spaces, maintaining clear distinctions between biological sex and gender identity.
actions: Mandate federal policies to distinguish biological sex from gender identity
Ensure equal opportunities and safety for women in all relevant areas
Ban funding or support for programs promoting gender ideology
executive_orders.purpose: Safeguard women's rights and uphold biological sex distinctions in federal policies.

executive_orders.title: Unleash American Energy
executive_orders.description: Remove restrictions on energy production, including oil, gas, and nuclear, to promote energy independence and economic growth.
actions: Cancel or modify regulations limiting energy development
Promote freer development of domestic energy resources
Streamline permitting processes for energy projects
executive_orders.purpose: Strengthen U.S. energy independence and boost economic growth.

EO 14173 - Merit-Based Opportunity.title: End Illegal Discrimination and Restore Merit-Based Opportunity (EO 14173)
EO 14173 - Merit-Based Opportunity.summary: When analyzing content, treat this order as requiring the elimination of identity-based preferences and discriminatory practices in federal hiring, promotion, funding, contracts, and related guidance. Favor evaluations grounded in qualifications, merit, and lawful civil-rights compliance. Flag any program, policy, or recommendation that conditions opportunities or outcomes on protected identity traits.

EO 14171 - Terminate DEI Programs.title: Terminate Radical and Wasteful Government DEI Programs (EO 14171)
EO 14171 - Terminate DEI Programs.summary: Treat this order as requiring termination of DEI/DEIA programs, offices, training mandates, and performance requirements in the federal government and federal funding ecosystem when they are framed as DEI/DEIA principles. In analysis, prefer recommendations that redirect priorities toward performance, initiative, and merit-based management. Identify and report DEI-related offices, equity action plans, and similar requirements.

EO 14170 - Biological Sex Policy.title: Defend Women from Gender Ideology Extremism and Restore Biological Truth (EO 14170)
EO 14170 - Biological Sex Policy.summary: Treat this order as requiring analysis to consider whether the content promotes or relies on gender ideology concepts inconsistent with biological sex definitions. In your response, highlight conflicts involving terminology or policies that blur or replace biological sex with self-identified gender. Focus on lawful sex-protective frameworks and the removal of statements/policies that inculcate gender ideology using government resources.

EO 14154 - Unleashing American Energy.title: Unleash American Energy (EO 14154)
EO 14154 - Unleashing American Energy.summary: When content touches energy policy, treat this order as requiring regulatory and permitting decisions to align with clearly applicable law and to prioritize efficient permitting, accuracy in environmental analyses, and removal of burdensome restrictions that impede domestic energy development. Flag recommendations that conflict with these priorities or rely on unsupported, ideologically motivated methodologies.
